application.submitted.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has been submitted successfully and is now queued for review. No action is required from you at this time.
application.submitted.email_body:
We are writing to confirm that your application {{application_number}} has been received by the Authority and has been entered into the licensing assessment process.

Your submission is now queued for an initial completeness review. Should any information be missing or require clarification, we will contact you through the Regulatory Portal with a formal request.

No action is required from you at this time. Please retain the application number above; it is the reference for all correspondence relating to this matter.

What happens next
Once the completeness review is concluded, the application will be allocated for assessment and you will be notified of any further requirements or of the determination in due course.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.submitted.applicant.in_app_message: Your {{license_type}} application {{application_number}} was submitted on {{submitted_at}} and is now under review. No action is required at this time.

application.approved_step.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has completed the {{step_name}} stage and has progressed to the next stage of assessment. No action is required from you at this time.

application.cancelled.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has been cancelled and is no longer under assessment. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal if you wish to review the record.

application.workflow_action_taken.in_app_message: {{actor_name}} recorded the action "{{action_type}}" on application {{application_number}}.{{#comments}} Remarks: {{comments}}{{/comments}}

application.comment_saved.in_app_message: A reviewer has added a query or remark to application {{application_number}}. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review it.
application.comment_saved.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}, which is currently under review by the Authority.

A remark has been recorded on the application file by {{reviewer_name}} as part of the assessment.

Remark
{{comments}}

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the remark in full and to provide any clarification requested. Where a formal information request accompanies the remark, the required response and supporting documents should be submitted through the portal.

What happens next
The Authority will continue its assessment once any clarification requested has been received.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.rfi_raised.in_app_message: Additional information is required to continue the assessment of application {{application_number}}.{{#item_count}} Items outstanding: {{item_count}}.{{/item_count}}{{#due_at}} Please respond by {{due_at}}.{{/due_at}}
application.rfi_raised.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}, which is currently under assessment by the Authority.

As part of our review, additional information is required before the assessment can continue.{{#item_count}} A total of {{item_count}} item(s) have been raised for your attention.{{/item_count}}

{{#summary}}Summary of the request
{{summary}}

{{/summary}}Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal, open the information request recorded against application {{application_number}}, and provide a response to each item together with any supporting documents.

{{#due_at}}Deadline
Please provide your response by {{due_at}}. If you are unable to respond by that date, please advise the Authority through the portal, stating the reason.

{{/due_at}}What happens next
Once your response is received it will be reviewed and, where the information provided is sufficient, the assessment of your application will continue.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.rfi_near_due.in_app_message: The information request on application {{application_number}} is due by {{due_date}}. Please submit your response through the Regulatory Portal.
application.rfi_near_due.email_body:
We are writing further to the information request issued in connection with application {{application_number}}.

Our records indicate that a response to the outstanding items has not yet been received.

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal and provide the requested information and supporting documents against each outstanding item.

Deadline
A response is required by {{due_date}}.

What happens next
Once your response is received, the Authority will continue its assessment. If a response is not received by the date stated, the application may be delayed or determined on the information currently available.

If you have already responded, please disregard this reminder.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.rfi_overdue.in_app_message: The information request on application {{application_reference}} was due by {{due_at}} and remains outstanding. Please respond through the Regulatory Portal without further delay.
application.rfi_overdue.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_reference}}.

Our records indicate that the information requested by the Authority was due by {{due_at}} and has not yet been received. The assessment of the application cannot continue while these items remain outstanding.

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal and provide the outstanding information and supporting documents without further delay. If there is a reason for the delay, please record it against the request so that it can be taken into account.

What happens next
Once your response is received the assessment will resume. Where information remains outstanding, the Authority may proceed to determine the application on the information available to it, or close the application in accordance with its procedures.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.send_back.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has been returned to you for correction at the {{step_name}} stage. Please review the reviewer's remarks in the Regulatory Portal and resubmit.
application.send_back.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}, which has been reviewed by the Authority at the {{step_name}} stage.

The application cannot proceed in its current form and has been returned to you so that the matters identified during review may be addressed.

{{#comments}}Matters to be addressed
{{comments}}

{{/comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal, address each of the matters identified, and resubmit the application together with any revised or additional supporting documents.

What happens next
Once your resubmission is received, the Authority will resume its assessment from the point at which the application was returned.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.resubmission_requested.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} requires resubmission. Please review the matters raised in the Regulatory Portal, correct the application and resubmit it.
application.resubmission_requested.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}, which has been considered by the Authority.

The application cannot be determined in its current form. It has therefore been made available to you again so that the matters identified may be addressed and the application resubmitted.

{{#comments}}Matters to be addressed
{{comments}}

{{/comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal, revise the application to address each matter identified, attach any further supporting documents required, and resubmit the application.

What happens next
Assessment of the application will resume once a complete resubmission has been received.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.resubmitted.applicant.in_app_message: Your resubmission of application {{application_number}} was received on {{resubmitted_at}} and is now under review. No action is required at this time.

application.rejected.in_app_message: A determination has been issued on application {{application_number}}: the application has not been approved. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the formal communication.
application.rejected.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}.

The Authority has completed its assessment of the application. Following that assessment, the application has not been approved.

{{#comments}}Reasons recorded by the Authority
{{comments}}

{{/comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the formal determination and any accompanying documentation in full.

What happens next
Where the governing legislation provides a right of review or appeal, the formal determination sets out how and within what period such a request may be made. A fresh application may also be submitted where the matters that led to this outcome have been addressed.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.final_approved.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has been approved and licence {{license_number}} has been issued. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review your licence details.
application.final_approved.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}.

The Authority has completed its assessment of the application and the application has been approved. Licence number {{license_number}} has been issued in consequence of that decision.

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the licence record, the licence certificate once available, and any conditions or ongoing obligations attaching to the licence.

What happens next
You are required to conduct licensed activities in accordance with the terms and conditions of the licence and the applicable regulatory requirements, including any periodic reporting obligations. Any material change to the information provided in your application must be notified to the Authority.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.decision_dispatched.in_app_message: The decision on application {{application_number}} has been issued. Outcome: {{outcome}}. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the formal decision.
application.decision_dispatched.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}.

The Authority has concluded its assessment and a formal decision has now been issued in respect of the application. The outcome recorded is: {{outcome}}.

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the formal decision communication and any accompanying documents, together with any conditions or further steps stated in it.

What happens next
Any requirement, condition or timeframe applying to you is set out in the formal decision. Where a right of review or appeal is available, the decision communication explains how it may be exercised.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

regulator.action_taken_on_application.in_app_message: The Authority has recorded the action "{{action_type}}" on application {{application_number}}. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal for details.

regulator.comment_added_or_query_raised.in_app_message: The Authority has raised a query on application {{application_number}}. Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review and respond.
regulator.comment_added_or_query_raised.email_body:
We are writing regarding application {{application_number}}, which is currently under review by the Authority.

A query has been raised by the reviewing officer in the course of the assessment.

Query
{{comments}}

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to review the query in full and to provide the clarification or documents requested.

What happens next
Once your response is received, the Authority will continue its assessment of the application.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

application.escalated_to_supervisor.in_app_message: Application {{application_number}} has been escalated to a senior reviewer for attention.
application.escalated_to_supervisor.email_body:
Application {{application_number}} has been escalated to a senior reviewer.

Action required
Please review the application file in the Regulatory Portal and progress the matter in accordance with the applicable assessment procedure.

Regards,
{{app_name}}
